title: Llama reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Llama body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='70' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- Llama neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='32' width='14' height='30' rx='6' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- Neck shading -->
  <rect x='38' y='32' width='5' height='30' rx='3' fill='#E8C88A'/>
  <!-- Llama head -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='32' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- Snout area -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='36' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='36' r='1' fill='#C8A876'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='29' r='2' fill='#5B3A1A'/>
  <circle cx='46.5' cy='28.5' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#F5DEB3' transform='rotate(-20 38 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='1.5' ry='4' fill='#FFB6C1' transform='rotate(-20 38 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#F5DEB3' transform='rotate(10 50 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='1.5' ry='4' fill='#FFB6C1' transform='rotate(10 50 21)'/>
  <!-- Llama legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#E8C88A'/>
  <rect x='40' y='82' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#E8C88A'/>
  <rect x='62' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='29' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <rect x='39' y='93' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <rect x='53' y='93' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <rect x='61' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <!-- Book - left page -->
  <path d='M20 60 L44 55 L44 78 L20 83 Z' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- Book - right page -->
  <path d='M44 55 L68 60 L68 83 L44 78 Z' fill='#FF8E8E'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='44' y1='56' x2='44' y2='77' stroke='#CC4444' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Book text lines left -->
  <line x1='24' y1='63' x2='40' y2='60' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='67' x2='40' y2='64' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='71' x2='40' y2='68' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='75' x2='38' y2='72' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Book text lines right -->
  <line x1='48' y1='60' x2='64' y2='63' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='64' x2='64' y2='67' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='68' x2='64' y2='71' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='72' x2='62' y2='75' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Book cover edge highlight -->
  <path d='M20 60 L44 55' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M44 55 L68 60' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Llama arm/paw holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- Fluffy chest -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='5' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='5' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='52' r='4' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='65' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#FFF8DC' transform='rotate(20 72 65)'/>
  <!-- Little smile line -->
  <path d='M50 38 Q52 40 54 38' stroke='#C8A876' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
</svg>
